```json
"rationale": "Rf≈160k sets Zt≈104 dBΩ and noise ≈320 fA/√Hz. High-gain CS stage (gm1≈160 µS, ~10 µA) gives a unity-gain frequency of about 500 MHz. Cf≈45 fF sets ζ≈0.7, so fn≈30 MHz. The follower (~12 µA) drives the 200 fF load with its pole above 150 MHz. vout=vin=Vgs1≈0.55 V. Budget is IREF+0.4·I1+I1+Isf ≈ 36 µA, about 65 µW."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "Rf":    (160e3, 130e3, 260e3),
    "Cf":    (45e-15, 10e-15, 150e-15),
    "I1":    (10e-6, 5e-6, 18e-6),
    "gmid1": (15.0, 10.0, 20.0),
    "L1":    (0.8, 0.3, 2.0),
    "Isf":   (12e-6, 6e-6, 20e-6),
    "gmsf":  (12.0, 8.0, 18.0),
    "Lsf":   (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),
    "Lp":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "kpb":   (0.4, 0.2, 1.0),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cpd = spec.get("cpd", 5e-13); cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6); vdd = 1.8
    Rf, Cf, I1, Isf = p["Rf"], p["Cf"], p["I1"], p["Isf"]
    Ipb = p["kpb"] * I1
    Lb = 1.0; gmb = 10.0

    # Input CS device: vin = vout = Vgs1 at DC
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=1.2)
    vin = m1.vgs
    # Source follower: source at vout (= vin), body effect included
    msf = lut.size("n", p["gmsf"], p["Lsf"], Isf, vds=0.7, vsb=vin)
    vx = vin + msf.vgs
    # PMOS current-source load and its diode
    mp = lut.size("p", 8.0, p["Lp"], I1, vds=max(vdd - vx, 0.2))
    mpd = lut.size("p", 8.0, p["Lp"], Ipb, vds=mp.vgs)
    # NMOS bias mirrors from ibias
    mb0 = lut.size("n", gmb, Lb, iref, vds=None or 0.6)
    mb0 = lut.size("n", gmb, Lb, iref, vds=mb0.vgs)
    msk = lut.size("n", gmb, Lb, Isf, vds=max(vin, 0.2))
    mbp = lut.size("n", gmb, Lb, Ipb, vds=max(vdd - mpd.vgs, 0.3))

    n = Netlist("iin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb0)
    n.dev("MBP", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mbp)
    n.dev("MPD", "pb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mpd)
    n.dev("MP1", "vx", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("M1", "vx", "iin", "vss", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("MSF", "vdd", "vx", "vout", "vss", msf)
    n.dev("MSK", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", msk)
    n.R("RF", "iin", "vout", Rf)
    n.C("CF", "iin", "vout", Cf)

    # ---- predictions ----
    asf = msf.gm / (msf.gm + msf.gmbs + msf.gds + msk.gds)
    a0 = m1.gm / (m1.gds + mp.gds) * asf
    cx = m1.cdd + mp.cdd + msf.cgd + 0.3 * msf.cgg + 2e-15
    wa = (m1.gds + mp.gds) / cx
    cin = cpd + m1.cgg
    ct = cin + Cf
    zt = Rf * a0 / (1 + a0)
    # second-order closed loop (amplifier ~ single pole; follower pole ignored)
    wu = a0 * wa
    wn2 = wu * (1 + 1 / a0) / (Rf * ct) if a0 > 0 else 1.0
    wn = math.sqrt(wn2)
    two_zw = (1 + wu * Rf * Cf + wa * Rf * ct) / (Rf * ct)
    z = two_zw / (2 * wn)
    k = 1 - 2 * z * z
    f3 = wn / (2 * PI) * math.sqrt(k + math.sqrt(k * k + 1))
    # follower/load pole derating
    wsf = (msf.gm + msf.gmbs) / (cl + Cf)
    f3 = f3 / math.sqrt(1 + (2 * PI * f3 / wsf) ** 2)

    kT4 = 4 * 1.380649e-23 * 300.15
    en2 = kT4 * 0.8 / m1.gm * (1 + mp.gm / m1.gm) * 1.5
    in2 = kT4 / Rf + en2 * (2 * PI * 1e6 * ct) ** 2
    power = vdd * (iref + Ipb + I1 + Isf)

    return n, {"zt_dbohm": db(zt), "f3db": f3, "power": power,
               "vout_dc": vin, "in_noise_1m": math.sqrt(in2)}
```
